test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Choose the odd one out.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
 

 Cucumber
 Vegetable
 
 

 Tomato
 Vegetable
 
 

 Cabbage
 leafy Vegetable
 
 

 Ladyfinger
 Vegetable
 
 

 

Cucumber, Tomato, Ladyfinger all are categorized as vegetables,

Whereas,

Cabbage is a leafy vegetable and stands out from the rest which are not leafy vegetables.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Cabbage**".
